# [STORY] As a Presenter, I want a local Cloudflare Tunnel option so that I can expose my local or Minikube backend to Vercel

## User Story
**As an** Presenter / Developer
**I want** a 1-command local Cloudflare Tunnel deployment for Docker and Minikube
**So that** I can expose my locally running microservices stack to the Vercel-deployed frontend via public HTTPS with zero cloud costs and zero VM provisioning.

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given the local Docker or Minikube stack running, when running `start-tunnel.sh`, then a `cloudflared` container launches and exposes the API Gateway over public HTTPS.
- [x] Given a Minikube cluster, when applying the local Kubernetes overlay, then an optional Cloudflare tunnel deployment is available to expose the NodePort gateway.
- [x] Given an active tunnel, when the public HTTPS URL is generated, then it can be copied directly or auto-synced to connect the Vercel frontend.
- [x] Given the Admin DeployControl UI, when viewing local options, then it displays instructions and status for local Cloudflare Tunnel connectivity.

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Notes
Provides an instant, $0-cost alternative to cloud VMs by exposing the local workstation or Minikube cluster directly.
